items.title: Another Tragic Reminder: Too. Many. Damn. Guns.
items.content: Bend has done more than its part watering the tree of liberty.

items.title: You’re Not Gonna Like the List of Donors Fronting the Bill for Trump’s Big, Ugly Ballroom
items.content: A White House spokesperson called them “a wide array of great American companies and generous individuals.” I call them a bunch of influence-buying grifters.

items.title: I’m Both Elated and Terrified to Hear That Trump’s Administration Is Coming Unstrung
items.content: A disastrous new press secretary. Whispers of a new chief of staff. A feud between the president and old lawyers. We have to endure two more years of this?

items.title: Trump Wants to Sell Ukraine Out for a Couple Days’ Worth of Diesel Fuel
items.content: And you’ll never guess the pale pile of evil he brought in to help.

items.title: The Ridiculous Tinfoil-Hat Theory That May Have Pushed the Trump Administration to Start the War with Iran
items.content: This conspiratorial threat has been a bogeyman for the do-your-own-research techno-right for so long that it dates back to when Newt Gingrich was considered a political visionary.

items.title: The Debut of Trump’s New Press Secretary Was an Unmitigated Disaster
items.content: Katie Zacharia’s first briefing began with the stilted recital of a homily about Trump’s greatness. It somehow got more awkward from there.

items.title: Trump’s Fundamental Electoral Strategy Is Violence
items.content: Chants of “USA!” rang out at the president’s Ohio rally after a MAGA goon punched a protester in the face. Bet you can’t guess who got high-fived and who got escorted out of the venue.

items.title: Trump’s Elevation of Ken Paxton Gets a Little Dumber Every Single Day
items.content: The president’s handpicked Senate candidate just turned up in a video of a New Year’s Eve party in Dubai. With two fugitives. And a woman who wasn’t his wife. Game knows game, man.

items.title: There Are So Many Things Wrong with What the DOJ Is Doing to Rep. Ilhan Omar
items.content: Xenophobia and racism almost certainly played a role in why her residence was searched by Homeland Security agents.

items.title: The White House Disinformation Machine Is Doing Its Best to Derail a Potentially Huge Midterm Swing
items.content: Senate candidate James Talarico never checked himself into a mental-health clinic in early October, but right-wing media sure took that BS story and ran with it.

items.title: In Trump’s America, Those Who Tell the Truth Are Punished
items.content: Former White House aide Cassidy Hutchinson is under fire for the testimony she gave during the January 6 investigation, which, to my ears, sounds pretty damn credible.

items.title: Is It Just Me, or Has the GOP Produced More Loony Midterm Candidates Than Ever Before?
items.content: One particularly crazy Republican out of Nevada wants to verify voters’ identities by “measuring their heartbeats.”

items.title: Is There Anyone Connected to Trump Who Isn’t Trying to Grift off His Presidency?
items.content: Kimberly Guilfoyle sure hasn’t been afraid to use her position as U.S. ambassador for shady wheeling and dealing.

items.title: Trump’s Making Allies with All the Wrong People in All the Wrong Places
items.content: Right-wing crazies from around the world are starting to find him useful. That’s more than a little dangerous.
